summary: The comment emphasizes the importance of maintaining E-Rate services for rural schools and libraries, which are crucial for education access in low-income areas. The comment opposes any efforts to sunset or limit E-Rate funding, arguing that without it, these institutions will suffer further educational disadvantages.

claims.requested_action: Continue or improve E-Rate service provision
claims.argument: Without E-Rate, libraries and schools will lose high-speed connectivity, worsening education access
claims.evidence_quote: Idaho public libraries and schools CANNOT lose high speed connectivity from E-Rate!!! We are a very rural state with low-income households being a prevalent factor. Without the connections provided by our libraries we will become even lower on the education scale than we already are!
